newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX BRENT EDGES UP DESPITE IPE'S HEFTY LOSSES.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX BRENT EDGES UP DESPITE IPE'S HEFTY LOSSES.

text.p: September Brent futures on SIMEX were untraded at midday on Thursday, but were quoted marginally firmer, seeking direction from NYMEX, brokers said.
SIMEX Brent was quoted at $19.15/19.25 per barrel for September.
September Brent on IPE fell by 32 cents per barrel to close at $19.20, as traders braced themselves for the resumption of Iraqi crudes within the next fortnight.
Singapore brokers expected SIMEX to move in line with WTI futures, which had been trading steadily around the $20.45/50 mark since Wednesday evening.
But trading on SIMEX was likely to be thin, they said.
"It's very quiet on the front" said a broker.
NYMEX crudes on ACCESS were last traded at $20.45 per barrel, down one cent from New York, which saw a fall of 35 cents per barrel.
